title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE RECLAMATION AUTHORITY (PRA) FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS

text.en:
The Philippine Reclamation Authority is hereby transferred
from the Department of Finance (DOF) to the Department of Public Works and
Highways (DPWH).

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
PEES Holagram / 37826

This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen (15) days after
its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of December, in the year of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
Mari Mr. Area,
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
MGMA Hatagram • 37827
